summary: Regression coverage for the SELECT * -> explicit column list trim across 6 backend files (portfolio.py, admin.py exports, prep.py, processing.py, doc_uploads.py, transcription_pipeline.py). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter117_select_star_trim.py: 25 tests covering: full-app sanity (login all 4 roles + meetings list + jane cross-user isolation), portfolio for attendee/admin/manager with numeric-consistency cross-check, all 4 admin exports (evidence CSV+PDF, cqc-excerpts PDF, cc-excerpts PDF, transcripts POST), prep context/generate/carry-forward-missed, processing retry/diarize/retranscribe (assert not-500 on real & 404 on synthetic meeting), doc_uploads update_upload_evidence (404 path + real accept-and-persistence round trip on an existing evidence item). All 25/25 pass in 60s after clearing the pre-existing 10/hour export rate limit. Bytes verified: evidence-csv non-empty; evidence-pdf, cqc-excerpts, cc-excerpts all start with %PDF magic + >500 bytes. export-transcripts still 404s because the 3 signed-off meetings in seed data have transcript_id NULL (pre-existing data condition, iteration 116 already flagged; not a code fault of this change — endpoint no longer 500s and returns clean 404). Frontend spot-checked on preview URL: admin dashboard shows the same 15/3/3 meeting counts as iteration 116, standards library renders (CQC 47, Care Cert 16), attendee 'My Portfolio' renders with the trimmed-column-derived stats block (0 records for user@ is correct — not a supervisee on any signed-off meeting), jane sees exactly 1 meeting (isolation intact). No 500s, no KeyError, no missing-field crashes anywhere.

minor.issue: Still returns 404 'No transcripts found' because all 3 signed_off meetings have transcript_id NULL — same pre-existing data-only issue flagged in iteration_116; not attributable to this column trim.

action_items: No action items — the SELECT * -> explicit column trim is fully non-regressive across portfolio, admin exports, prep, processing, and doc_uploads. Main agent may ship.
